title: Record token lease closed during uploader activity

annotations.summary: Record token lease closed during uploader activity
annotations.user_impact: Audio remains retained; record closure must not race an active uploader.
annotations.scope: Server-observed custody appends/frame batches only. Backlog warning requires recent lease-based release activity.
annotations.verification: Inspect late-append rate, signal-gap histogram and oldest unsealed age. No user-data reads required.
annotations.safe_next_action: P4 auto-revert RECORD_TOKEN_LEASE_MODE to shadow/off; retain all raw audio; lead2 go before the next step.
annotations.threshold: Any late append pages immediately; non-falling backlog age warns during lease release activity.
annotations.evaluated_bad: Synthetic late-append counter increases, or positive age slope with lease releases.
annotations.evaluated_good: Synthetic zero late-appends and falling oldest-unsealed age.

title: Record token lease backlog age is not falling

model.expr: (deriv((last_over_time((max(omi_record_seal_oldest_age_seconds >= 0))[10m:]))[30m:]) >= bool 0) and on() (last_over_time((max(omi_record_seal_oldest_age_seconds >= 0))[10m:]) > 0) and on() (sum(increase(omi_record_token_lease_expired_sealed_total[1h])) > 0) or vector(0)
